name: Love At First Bite
tagline: Describe what you want to eat in plain words, swipe on restaurant cards and let the group's matches decide.

awards: [MLH] Best .Tech Domain Name // [MLH] Meilleur nom de domaine .Tech

problem: Groups waste time deciding where to eat; review apps overload them with information.
solution: An LLM turns a plain request into restaurant search parameters; results appear as swipe cards; a ranking combines the group's likes.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for a cozy cheap Italian spot and swipe to a match.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best .Tech Domain Name // [MLH] Meilleur nom de domaine .Tech” among 260 submissions.
Optimises for decision speed over information.

lessons: Borrow a familiar gesture for a decision people dread.
